title: About APSCVIR

blocks.text: About APSCVIR

The Asia Pacific Society of Cardiovascular and Interventional Radiology (APSCVIR) is an international organization that brings together interventional radiologists from the region, working to improve the level of clinical practice, education and research in the field of interventional radiology in the Asia Pacific Region. The society is a collaborative effort of 16 organizational members.
APSCVIR meets annually to encourage international exchange of knowledge vital to Cardiovascular & Interventional Radiology among medical doctors in different territories of the Asia Pacific region.
Objective of Society

Meet regularly to encourage international exchange of knowledge vital to cardiovascular and interventional radiology among radiologists, interventional radiologists and individuals in related fields in different countries of the Asia Pacific region.

title: Abstract

blocks.text: Key Dates of Late-Breaking Abstract
Submission opens: 30 March 2026
Submission closes: 12 April 2026
Notification of results: 26 April 2026

Late-Breaking Abstracts are intended for high-impact, practice-changing research that could not be submitted by the regular abstract deadline due to the timing of data analysis or study completion. If you have important new findings that advance the field of cardiovascular and interventional radiology, we warmly encourage you to submit.
1. Submitted data must be original, unpublished, and not presented at any other meeting prior to APSCVIR 2026.
2. Studies should report final results or key interim analyses that became available only after the regular abstract submission deadline.
3. All submissions will undergo peer review . Acceptance will be highly competitive due to the limited number of presentation slots.
* Abstracts must be submitted by the submission deadline, which is 12 April 2026 (23:59 GMT+8).
Abstract Category

1. Artificial intelligence (AI) 2. Biliary intervention 3. Biopsy and drainage 4. Bone, spine and soft tissue intervention 5. Chemoembolization (TACE) 6. Dialysis intervention and venous access 7. Embolotherapy (excluding oncology) 8. EVAR and TEVAR 9. Experimental work in IR 10. GI tract intervention 11. IVC filters 12. Management in IR (including clinical practice) 13. Neuro and/or carotid intervention 14. Non-thermal ablation (including IRE) 15. Pain management 16. Peripheral vascular disease intervention 17. Radiation safety and sustainability 18. Radioembolization (TARE) 19. Renal and visceral artery intervention 20. Thermal ablation 21. TIPS and portal vein intervention 22. Trauma embolization 23. Urinary tract intervention 24. Vascular malformations and lymphatic intervention 25. Venous intervention 26. Others
Submission Guidelines

1. The abstract words limit is 800 with a minimum requirement of 100 words (excluding title, author information, and affiliations). 2. All abstract submissions are required to contain the following information for consideration and review: ● Purpose ● Materials and methods ● Results ● Conclusion ● Table and Figures (Optional) ● References (Optional) 3. Abstracts must be submitted by the submission deadline, which is 31 December 2025, (23:59 GMT+8).

blocks.text: AKAMS Travel Grants
Supported by the Asia–Korea–Africa Medical Scholarship Association (AKAMS), APSCVIR 2026 will provide travel grants to support eligible participants from the Asia-Pacific region.
Grant Details
Number of awards: 10
Grant amount: USD 500 per awardee
Purpose: Travel support for participation in APSCVIR 2026
Meeting dates and venue: June 11–14, 2026, Suzhou, China
Eligibility
Applicants must meet all of the following criteria:
International residents, fellows, or early-career interventional radiologists (≤ 35 years; recommendation letter from the head of department required)
Based in the Asia-Pacific region
Presenting authors of abstracts accepted for APSCVIR 2026
Application Process
Eligible applicants should submit an application by email to:
Email: info@apscvir-2026.com
The application should include:
Full name
Institution
Accepted abstract title and abstract ID
Brief curriculum vitae
Recommendation letter from the head of department
Passport photo page
Deadline for application: January 31, 2026
Award Notification
AKAMS Travel Grant recipients will be notified by email prior to the APSCVIR 2026 meeting.
ISMIO Abstract Awards

The International Society of Multidisciplinary Interventional Oncology (ISMIO) will provide abstract awards to support presenters at APSCVIR 2026, recognizing excellence in IR research and academic contribution.
Award Categories
ISMIO Oral Abstract Awards - Top 10 oral abstracts, USD 300 per award
ISMIO Poster Abstract Awards - Top 10 poster abstracts, USD 200 per award
Award Announcement
ISMIO award recipients will be announced during the Gala Dinner at APSCVIR 2026.
Important Note
ISMIO abstract awards are reserved for presenters who are not recipients of the AKAMS travel grant.
The awardees are selected by the Scientific Committee and are independent of nationality.
Invited speakers are not eligible for Abstract Awards.

title: Transportation

blocks.text: 📍 Venue: Hall A1, Suzhou International Expo Center
🏠 Address: No. 688 East Suzhou Avenue, Suzhou Industrial Park, Suzhou
🚇 Metro: Take Metro Line 1 to Culture & Expo Center Station and leave via Exit 3.
🚗 Self-Travel Guidance
✈️ From Shanghai Hongqiao Airport
Option 1: High-speed rail (Recommended / Fastest)
Airport → Hongqiao Railway Station: Walk or Metro Line 2/10 (≈20 min)
Train to Suzhou Industrial Park Station / Suzhou Station / Suzhou North Station (≈25–35 min)
Option 2: Airport bus
Take the Hongqiao Airport–Suzhou bus and get off at Suzhou Industrial Park (International Building) .
Take a taxi for about RMB 15, or walk to Central Park Station on Metro Line 1 and travel one stop to Culture & Expo Center Station.
Duration: 1.5h | Fare: ¥50
Option 3: Taxi / Driving
Distance: 80 km | Time: 1–1.5h | Cost: ¥300–350
✈️ From Shanghai Pudong Airport
Option 1: Metro + High-speed rail (Recommended)
Metro Line 2 (toward Xujing East) to Hongqiao Railway Station (≈1.5h)
High-speed rail to Suzhou (25–35 min)
Take the Pudong Airport–Suzhou bus and get off at Suzhou Industrial Park (International Building) .
Transfer: Taxi about ¥15, or walk to Central Park Station (Metro Line 1) .
Duration: 2.5h | Fare: ¥80
Distance: 130–150 km | Time: ≈2h | Cost: ¥450–500
🚆 From Suzhou Stations to Suzhou International Expo Center
Suzhou North Station
Metro: Line 2 (toward Sangtiandao) → Guangjinan Road (First: 05:44, Last: 23:44) → Line 1 (toward Zhongnanjie) to Culture & Expo Center Station, Exit 3 (First: 05:44, Last: 23:44) (50 min, ¥5)
Taxi: 17 km, 30 min, ¥45–50
Suzhou Station
Metro: Line 4 (toward Tongli) → Leqiao Station (First: 05:43, Last: 22:39) → Line 1 (toward Zhongnanjie) to Culture & Expo Center Station, Exit 3 (First: 06:03, Last: 22:58) (35 min, ¥4)
Bus: Express No.9, North Square of Suzhou Station (50 min, ¥2)
Taxi: 11 km, 20 min, ¥25–30
Suzhou Industrial Park Station
Taxi: 3–4 km, 10 min, ¥10–15 (Fastest)
Metro: Line 8 (toward Chefang) → Times Square (First: 06:15, Last: 22:55) → Line 1 (toward Mudu) to Culture & Expo Center Station, Exit 3 (First: 06:01, Last: 22:42)
Parking
There are about 3000 parking spaces around the venue.
Suzhou Expo offers free parking for four hours. And five yuan will be paid for each 30 minutes beyond the four hours. Less than 30 minutes will be deemed as 30 minutes for the parking.
The highest parking cost per car per day each time will be ￥100.
Cash, alipay, WeChat or bank cards are acceptable for the payment.
💡 Tip: We recommend using Amap or Baidu Maps for navigation in mainland China.
